note: Irregularities and open items for manual review. None of them blocks the merge. Unverified product values are listed separately on the Flagged page, generated from data/products.json.

flags.owner_action: Confirm the intended purpose and choose a license.

flags.detail: GET /repos/kanlerxz87-cyber/Zone1/pages returned build_type 'legacy', source branch 'main', path '/', status 'built', and html_url https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone1/. The plan is to switch the source to main /docs when the PR is merged. This is the only Pages setting change.

flags.item: Personal email address appears in public commit metadata.
flags.detail: The single commit 42f4036 'Initial commit' has author kanlerxz87-cyber <kanlerxz87@gmail.com>. Rewriting history was not done. Reported only.
flags.owner_action: Decide whether to keep the commit email public (GitHub noreply setting).

flags.item: Product identity from the submitted short links needs owner confirmation.
flags.detail: The three submitted codes (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV) are 9 characters, so they are not ASINs. Test on 2026-11-13: a direct request to amazon.com/dp/<code> returns Amazon "Page Not Found". A fake code (ZZZZZZZZZ) at link.amazon returns 403 Forbidden. The real codes redirect to ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. Two requests for P1 returned the same ASIN and source token. The redirect URLs carry lv=shuf and plpRedirect=mhFallback, which can indicate a fallback page. Another session reported different results on later requests. That was not reproduced here. The product identity is therefore not confirmed. Each row is marked identity_status "to confirm".
flags.owner_action: Open each submitted link in a browser while signed in and confirm it leads to the intended product. Send back the correct ASIN if it differs.

flags.item: Associates tag not visible in resolved product links (all 3 products).
flags.detail: The resolved URLs contain no tag= parameter. The Associates ID is not in the submission, so none was added. Commission attribution cannot be confirmed from here. Program Policies require the tag on every link.
flags.owner_action: Provide your Associates tag so the links can be rebuilt with it, or confirm the short links are attributed to your account.

flags.item: Product titles on the site are Amazon listing text.
flags.detail: Program Policies §6(a) says Program Content may not be altered. Whether listing titles count as Program Content is not confirmed. Titles are shown as read, without edits, and the site adds its own text around them.
flags.owner_action: Review whether titles may stay on the site, or replace them with the site's own product names.

flags.item: Commission rate is unverified for all 3 products.
flags.detail: The official rate schedule (affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/schedule) redirects to an Amazon sign-in page. Third-party sites report different rates for kitchen and home categories. Those figures are not official, so none were entered.
flags.owner_action: Check the Standard Commission Income rate for each product's category in Associates Central (sign-in required).

flags.item: Price, rating, review count, best-sellers rank, and availability are unverified for all 3 products.
flags.detail: The product pages were readable only for their titles. The price and review fields did not appear in the readable page content. Blank cells are marked UNVERIFIED. No value was filled in.
flags.owner_action: Supply a source that shows these values, such as a Creators API key, or accept the blanks.

flags.item: Automated product data is not possible without Creators API access.
flags.detail: PA-API 5 is deprecated and returns 403 AccessDenied. The Creators API needs Associates enrollment, at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days, and registered credentials. No credentials exist here, so no live price or review pulls were built.
flags.owner_action: Once the account qualifies, register for the Creators API and provide the credentials through a secret store (not the repo).

flags.item: Cookie and privacy disclosure needs legal review.
flags.detail: The site adds no analytics or cookies. Amazon's own pages may set cookies when a visitor clicks through, and Program Policies §3(e) requires accurate disclosure of cookies and pixels. The Sources page carries a short privacy note, which is not legal advice.
flags.owner_action: Have counsel confirm the privacy note.

flags.item: Click and conversion tracking is not implemented.
flags.detail: Clicks and sales data are only in the Associates account (Reports), which this environment cannot access. The site has no tracking code, so none is reported.
flags.owner_action: Export the Associates reports, or give access, so tracking can be added later.

flags.item: Niche, trend, competition, and pricing analysis is limited to what the titles state.
flags.detail: No official source available in this environment gives trend, best-seller, competitor, or price data. The analysis page uses only title facts and the stated formula. It makes no claim about which products convert best.
flags.owner_action: Decide which data source to add, such as the Creators API, after qualifying for access.
